title: UW–Madison chancellor special regent committee announces three finalists
summary_en: Candidate interviews and forums will be held on the UW–Madison campus next week.

title: Hope for the critically endangered northern muriqui monkey
summary_en: A new grant is providing $1 million over five years to go directly toward the conservation of Brazil’s peaceful primate population, and UW–Madison researcher Karen Strier will be leading the effort.
title_cn: Hope for the critically endangered northern muriqui monkey

title: UW’s Nobel laureate started his research with a question
summary_en: In an opinion piece for the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel, interim Chancellor Eric Wilcots makes the case for giving researchers the resources necessary to pursue answers to curiosity-driven questions.
title_cn: UW’s Nobel laureate started his research with a question
